author: GameTrailers
description: Disney and Epic Games have announced Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit, a new Unreal Engine Fortnite collaboration that extends the story of Star Wars Millennium Falcon: Smuggler's Run from Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge in Disneyland and Disney Hollywood Studios. Play it starting on August 16.
title: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit – Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the new Operator, Noor, and see him in action as he takes the lead on a critical mission in this latest Rainbow Six Siege trailer. Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3 brings the new Operator Noor, modernized maps, operator and weapon balancing updates, and more. Rainbow Six Siege's Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3 will be available on September 1, 2026.
title: Rainbow Six Siege - Official 'Noor Saves the Day' Anime Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Noor Operator Gameplay Overview Trailer for Rainbow Six Siege X, the tactical action first-person shooter developed by Ubisoft. Players can get the rundown on new gameplay from Noor, a new Operator coming to the game. Noor joins as a new Egyptian Defender, using his Horus Lance Launcher to burn through walls, floors, and... shields. Play as Noor in Rainbow Six Siege's Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3, launching on September 1, 2026.
title: Rainbow Six Siege - Official Noor Operator Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the release date trailer for Minsgon Simulator, a collectathon simulation game developed by 
Vokcen. Hatch mysterious eggs and discover over 150 Minsgon species!  Tame, raise, and train wild creatures to help them evolve, then showcase and sell them in your shop and garden. Unlock new skills and rise to fame in the world of Minsgon! Minsgon Simulator is launching on August 21 for PC (Steam).
title: Minsgon Simulator - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
TCG Card Shop Simulator gets a new 90s Saturday morning cartoon-inspired trailer and a release date. Watch the 90s Saturday morning cartoon-inspired TCG Card Shop Simulator trailer for this management sim game. The new trailer also showcases store management gameplay and more. TCG Card Shop Simulator is out now in Early Access, and version 1.0 will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 15, 2026.

In TCG Card Shop Simulator, open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop. Version 1.0 brings the playable Tetramon TCG, where players can battle with the cards they collect.
title: TCG Card Shop Simulator - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Year 3 Season 2 Crimson Waters Story Trailer for Skull and Bones, the hit naval-focused action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft. Players can get a look at the latest offerings with the new Y3S2 Crimson Waters Story. The Y3S2 Crimson Waters will be available August 18 on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Skull and Bones - Official Y3S2 Crimson Waters Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the new Operator, Noor, and see him in action in this latest Rainbow Six Siege trailer. Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3 brings the new Operator Noor, the new SoloQ-only Legend Division playlist, the Wasteland Circuit event, a targeted map update for Villa, modernized maps, operator and weapon balancing updates, and more. Rainbow Six Siege's Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3 will be available on September 1, 2026.
title: Rainbow Six Siege - Official Operation Split Fire Year 11 Season 3: New Operator Noor Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for Fatberg, a classic horror game developed by Lilou Studio. In Fatberg (a hardened lump of waste matter that accumulates throughout sewer systems), you are a lowly janitor who has been forced to do the dangerous job of breaking apart fatbergs in the sewers just before a rainstorm. Unfortunately, unspeakable things are living deep down in those sewers who do not like to be disturbed, and they won't let such easy prey leave their underworld alive. As players explore the sewers for fatbergs, they won't know what they will find around every dark and slimy corner. Fatberg is launching on September 1 for PC (Steam).
title: Fatberg - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Villages on Wheels, a strategic horde survival game developed by Remssi. Players will build and expand their moving village while fighting endless waves of monsters. You don't wait for the monsters to come knocking at your door, instead, you drive head-on into the battle! Villages on Wheels will be available soon on PC (Steam).
title: Villages on Wheels - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for Dino Party, the chaotic player party brawler developed by Studio Nachtwer. Players will tussle over bubbling lava pits, winter wonderlands, falling sky-high platforms, and other elemental arenas in online or local multiplayer play with up to four dinos. Dodge fatal stage hazards, punch each other silly, shield oncoming attacks, and outplay other dinos trying to earn stars across dozens of minigames altered by each arena — then deck out your own dino with over 120 unlockable cosmetics. Dino Party is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Dino Party - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!, a cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement developed by Frost Luna Studio. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets, and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class, and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier. Roll for Order: Sort Every Set! will be available soon on PC (Steam).
title: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set! - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Two Sides of Hell, a 2D bullet hell action roguelike shooter developed by Red Sky Games.
